author: ElRaptorus
description: Development Studio for modeling BPMN and DMN diagrams for BFW-Engine.
name: @elraptorus/bfw_studio

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:studio
scripts.build:sdk: npm ci --prefix ../studio-sdk && npm run build --prefix ../studio-sdk && npm install file:../studio-sdk
scripts.build:studio: npm run clean && rspack build --config rspack.config.electron.js
scripts.build-prod:electron:prepare: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:studio && electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.build-prod:electron:mac: npm run build:sdk && npm run build-prod:electron:prepare && electron-builder -c build/electron-builder.js --publish never -m
scripts.build-prod:electron:windows: npm run build:sdk && npm run build-prod:electron:prepare && electron-builder -c build/electron-builder.js --publish never -w
scripts.build-prod:electron:linux: npm run build:sdk && npm run build-prod:electron:prepare && electron-builder -c build/electron-builder.js --publish never -l
scripts.test:integration:all: npm run build:plugin-fixtures && cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:bpmn-editor: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/bpmn-editor/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:bpmn-landscape: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/bpmn-landscape/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:dmn-editor: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/dmn-editor/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:core: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/studio-core/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:git-cruiser: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/git-cruiser/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:deploy: cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/deploy/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration:plugins: npm run build:plugin-fixtures && cross-env APP_TEST=true WDIO_LOG_LEVEL=silent vitest run test/integration/plugins/ --bail 1 --retry 1 --no-file-parallelism
